Dave Matthews Band
May 17, 2022
Brandon Amphitheater
Brandon, Mississippi

Taper: Mark Terrell, linked up with Henry Hart
Location: Back of FOH, 15 feet up
Source: Schoeps MK4s > Actives > Babynbox > Tascam DR-05X (24/48)
Lineage: WAV > Audacity 2.3.2 (Gain, Mixing, Normalizing, Fades, Tracking) > FLAC (Level 8)

Setlist:
01. Introduction
02. Seek Up
03. Warehouse
04. Grace Is Gone
05. Break for It
06. Tripping Billies
07. Old Dirt Hill (Bring That Beat Back)
08. Madman's Eyes
09. Jimi Thing
10. When the World Ends
11. Walk Around the Moon
12. Grey Street
13. Break Free
14. Funny the Way It Is
15. What Would You Say
16. Crush
17. Don't Drink the Water
18. You & Me
19. Two Step
20. Encore Break
21. The Space Between
22. Why I Am

Dave Matthews Band:
Dave Matthews - Guitar, Lead Vocals
Tim Reynolds - Electric Guitar
Stefan Lessard - Bass
Buddy Strong - Keyboards, Vocals
Rashawn Ross - Trumpet, Vocals
Jeff Coffin - Saxophone, Flute
Carter Beauford - Drums

Thank you to Henry Hart for the clamp space and for linking up to tape the show.
Thank you to Tommy from the DMB sound team for his constant support of the DMB taping scene.

Compiled by Mark Terrell on 2022/05/19.
